verdict.rationale: Statsig ships an official CLI for managing Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs, and its docs say the CLI can be integrated into CI/CD pipelines for automation. A versioned Console CRUD API with a public OpenAPI spec covers headless actions without the web UI. The probe-detected OpenAPI 404s are on other paths, while the versioned spec at api.statsig.com is documented, so there is no dispute. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and detailed CI auth/setup documentation in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can integrate the CLI into CI/CD pipelines to automate the management of Feature Gates and Experiments.
The Statsig CLI is a command-line interface that helps manage Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs within the Statsig platform.
The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
